import os
import js7
##!include agent-register.scriptinclude 
order_ids = client.order.operate.add_orders(
    controller_id=os.environ.get("JS7_CONTROLLER_ID"),
    orders=[
        js7.model.Order(
            order_name=os.environ.get("ORDER_NAME"),
            workflow_path=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW_PATH")
        )
    ]
)

order_id = order_ids[0] if isinstance(order_ids, list) else order_ids

print("Created Order ID:", order_id)

return_values_file = os.environ.get("JS7_RETURN_VALUES")
if return_values_file:
    with open(return_values_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"order_id_shell={order_id}\n")

import js7
import os
##!include agent-register.scriptinclude 
order_id_shell = os.environ.get("order_id_shell", "").strip()
print(f"Confirming order: {order_id_shell}")
confirm_result = client.order.operate.confirm_orders(
    controller_id=os.environ.get("JS7_CONTROLLER_ID"),
    order_ids=[order_id_shell]
)

print("Confirmed:", confirm_result)

import os
##!include agent-register.scriptinclude 
order_id_shell = os.environ.get("order_id_shell", "").strip()

    controller_id=os.environ.get("JS7_CONTROLLER_ID"),
    filter=js7.model.SuspendOrderFilter(
        order_ids=[order_id_shell],
        kill=os.environ.get("KILL", "false").lower() == "true"
    )
)

print("Suspended:", ok)
